capabilities: Open global and local 3D graphs with zoom, rotate, and pan
Filter nodes by query, attachments, and orphans
Group and color nodes using queries
Search and focus on nodes, or fly to a node with Ctrl/cmd-click
Select multiple nodes and run batch commands
extras: README warns the underlying 3D graph has unresolved performance issues, so a max node number limit can be set to keep the computer from hanging; the 3d-graph code block embed is explicitly marked unstable work-in-progress; also installable via BRAT or manual build with bun, and the author requests sponsorship or code contributors.
intentEvidence: Just want to say thanks to those people. Without them, this repo will not be here. - The original repo:
motivation: The author says they developed it for free, prioritizing functions over fanciness and scheduling work by impact, confidence, and effort.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Graph view is 2D and offers limited control over filtering, grouping, and navigating large link structures.
summary: 3D graph view that renders vault links in three dimensions with local graphs, node filtering, grouping, search focus, and batch node commands.
